behaviors.name: stops at the checkpoint
behaviors.check: After concepts.png exists the assistant shows it and waits; vectorize/mockups/kit are not run unless --autopilot or the user picked.

behaviors.name: spelling gate
behaviors.check: No pick on the sheet has spelled_right=false or extra_text=true in judge.json.

behaviors.name: shelf before directions
behaviors.check: When shelf.json exists, no direction's main palette color maps to a hue in census.owned.

behaviors.name: one attempt
behaviors.check: No generation, fetch or edit is retried in a loop; failures are logged and the run continues or stops.

behaviors.name: white becomes paper
behaviors.check: kit/png/final-2048.png has a transparent background and transparent letter counters; cream fills survive.

behaviors.name: looks before showing
behaviors.check: The transcript shows the assistant opening concepts.png, tests.png and every on-product render before the user sees them.

behaviors.name: kit sizes
behaviors.check: amazon/brand-store-logo-400.png and sponsored-brands-logo-400.png are 400x400 with a white background; shopify/header-logo-800x200.png is 800x200 transparent; favicon.ico contains 16/32/48.

behaviors.name: no trademark claim
behaviors.check: board.html, kit/README.md and the delivery message each say the kit does not clear trademarks.

behaviors.name: cost line
behaviors.check: The delivery message states the spend from cost.jsonl; a default run is under $1.

behaviors.name: engine lock
behaviors.check: Only gpt-image-2 and gpt-5.4 are called; no Gemini, fal, kie or other image model, even on failure.
